title: CRISP: Fixing Flying Pixels in Latent LiDAR Generation via Diffusion Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.11376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent LiDAR pipelines suffer from flying pixels: convolutional VAEs blur sharp radial depth discontinuities, yielding edge depths that back-project to points floating between surfaces. We identify this as a major, directly correctable decoder bottleneck and introduce CRISP: a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a backbone-agnostic latent adapter, DiT-based denoiser, and support mask predictor. CRISP replaces video-VAE and LiDAR-native decoders alike while keeping the encoder and latent generator fixed. Across KITTI-360, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes, replacing only the decoder reduces FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average across frozen backbones; for generic video VAEs, the reductions reach 71%/74%. On the LiDAR-native LiDM backbone, FRID drops by 71%, with the largest gains at depth discontinuities. In a pretrained LiDM world model, the same zero-shot replacement improves FSVD by 15.5%, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

translated_title: CRISP：通过扩散解码修复潜在LiDAR生成中的飞点问题
translated_abstract: 潜在LiDAR生成流程一直受到飞点问题的困扰：卷积VAE会模糊尖锐的径向深度不连续区域，导致边缘深度在反投影后产生悬浮于不同表面之间的点。我们将此确定为一个主要且可直接修复的解码器瓶颈，并提出CRISP：一个像素空间扩散解码器，包含与骨干网络无关的潜在适配器、基于DiT的去噪器以及支持掩码预测器。CRISP既可以替换视频VAE解码器，也可以替换LiDAR原生解码器，同时保持编码器和潜在生成器不变。在KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，仅替换解码器即可在冻结骨干网络的情况下平均降低FSVD/FPVD达50.5%；对于通用视频VAE，降低幅度可达71%/74%。在LiDAR原生的LiDM骨干网络上，FRID下降71%，且在深度不连续处增益最大。在预训练的LiDM世界模型中，同样的零样本替换使FSVD改善15.5%，缩小了仿真到现实的差距。
tldr: 提出CRISP像素空间扩散解码器，通过仅替换潜在LiDAR生成流程中的VAE解码器来消除飞点伪影，在多个数据集上将FSVD/FPVD平均降低50.5%，并可零样本迁移至预训练世界模型。
en_tdlr: CRISP is a pixel-space diffusion decoder that fixes flying pixels in latent LiDAR generation by simply replacing VAE decoders, reducing FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average and enabling zero-shot improvement in pretrained LiDM world models.
